name: an open laptop runs an agent's live log
looks: A clean 3D laptop render sits open on black, its screen filling with a dark terminal where an agent's task log scrolls line by line (reading a file, updating code, running tests), under a headline naming how long it has been running.
build: glass-ui-flow's typing/terminal pattern: the laptop is a lit 3D render (studio key light, soft shadow); the terminal lines type and scroll upward on a steady clock-driven cadence, with coloured status words (passed, updated) flashing in.
sound: A soft keystroke texture, a faint fan hum under the render.
prompt: Render a clean 3D hero shot of a laptop open on black, its screen filled with a terminal log scrolling through real task steps (reading, updating, testing) under a headline naming how long the work has been running. Keep the device lighting crisp and the log small and dense, like a real background process.
